description: This file defines the ConfigStore enum that manages application configuration data, including loading and saving configurations remotely via a gateway or locally. It also supports override mechanisms for testing and debugging.

classes.name: Overrides
classes.description: A struct encapsulating various override functions for configuration loading and saving.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class that stores override configurations atomically.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Determines if the application should operate in remote mode, either via override or default app state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the configuration data either from remote gateway or local fallback, considering overrides.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration data either remotely via gateway or locally, considering overrides.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches configuration snapshot from remote gateway connection.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Sends configuration data to remote gateway, with hash management to optimize updates.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Sets override configurations for testing (debug build only).

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Clears override configurations for testing (debug build only).
